registeredSourceTerm.description: Overlay for the source terms that Neko-TOP registers: they read no key from the case file.
registeredSourceTerm.$comment: sources/source_terms/neko_top_source_terms.f90:71-78 registers the five types; their init_from_json is empty (simple_brinkman_source_term.f90:110-123 and its siblings), so only `type` is meaningful. Neko's registered-type fallback already admits them; this overlay only rejects the keys nothing reads.
